name: real-cadenced-metcon-short-run-20260730
description: REAL saved doc (JqbuaciOE8rrWaNLFa7O, metcon part). Cadenced intervals whose rounds each open with a SHORT run: 5 x (200m run + 8 power cleans + 8 box jumps) = 1 km of running beside 80 reps of barbell and box. The hero must be the 80 REPS. Any cardio at all used to hand the hero to the cardio leg, printing 'DISTANCE / 1.0' — a bare number with no unit anywhere on the card, naming neither the machine nor the work that actually filled the intervals. A run only outranks reps once it reaches 2 km (a bike, 5 km); below that it is a leg inside the workout, not its result.
